facts.label: Starter-zone book
facts.value: Starting zones drop quest items that teach a gathering profession and give +2 skill. The herbalism one is Wild Harvest.

facts.label: Scarce herbs
facts.value: Frilled Lichen, Rosecap and Stranglevine are new scarce herbs that alchemists turn into dyes.

facts.label: Camp objects
facts.value: Incense Candle at skill 20, Greenhouse at 140 (blueprint from Shadetooth in the Excavation Site: Wetlands) and Seed Hybridizer at 300. The Candle's buff matches Arcane Intellect and does not stack with it.

facts.label: No passive bonus
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern's beta guide says professions give no passive stat bonuses.

facts.label: Level for each rank
facts.value: Guides disagree. Icy Veins lists no level for Journeyman, 10 for Expert and 25 for Artisan; Warcraft Tavern lists 10, 20 and 35, the same as crafts.

facts.label: Legacy perks
facts.value: Bountiful Harvest gives extra Scarce resources from gathering, and Working Overtime improves your skill-up chance.

facts.label: Switching
facts.value: To drop a primary profession, click the red X in the Professions window and type the confirmation. All skill and recipes are lost.

facts.label: Healing potion herbs
facts.value: Healing potions are now First Aid crafts that use Sungrass or Golden Sansam, so herbalists supply First Aid as well as Alchemy.

facts.note: Where the Seed Hybridizer blueprint drops.

facts.note: Whether any passive herbalism perk exists. Lists that circulate online, such as magic resistance for herbalists, are unverified.
